correctness.rationale: The weighted directed matrix-tree identity yields the cycle-conditioned degree factorial moment, and a finite sum yields z_n. Exact inclusion moments reduce covariance to the Johnson two-subset algebra, giving all dimensions and eigenvalues. Positivity, n=4 coincidence, n>=5 strict ordering and kappa^2<2 are proved by explicit positive polynomials. Gaussian-product summation proves the limiting sharp constant. Exact Fractions enumeration for n=4..7 independently checks every pair entry and representative eigenvectors; infinite claims rely on algebra, not tests.

value.rationale: The canonical one-cycle connected random graph class has a motivated Fourier problem: can all edge-additive observables be reconstructed stably from uniform graph samples? The complete two-sector spectrum, one-relation classification, exact tightness at n=4, strict universal sharp squared bound 2 and approach rate offer precise natural stability data. The cycle-length weighted degree-moment bridge is a reusable structural step, not an arbitrary slice or routine table recomputation.
